text: I am well aware that it would be disingenuous to resolve indiscriminately the opposition of any set of men (merely because their situations might subject them to suspicion) into interested or ambitious views.
zh: 我很清楚，不加区别地将任何一群人的反对意见（仅仅因为他们的处境可能使他们受到怀疑）转化为感兴趣或雄心勃勃的观点是不诚实的。
chunks: I am well aware that it would be disingenuous
to resolve indiscriminately the opposition
of any set of men (merely
because their situations might subject them
to suspicion) into interested or ambitious views.

text: To judge from the conduct of the opposite parties, we shall be led to conclude that they will mutually hope to evince the justness of their opinions, and to increase the number of their converts by the loudness of their declamations and the bitterness of their invectives.
chunks: To judge from the conduct of the opposite parties,
we shall be led to conclude that they will mutually hope
to evince the justness of their opinions,
and to increase the number of their converts by the loudness
of their declamations and the bitterness of their invectives.

text: I frankly acknowledge to you my convictions, and I will freely lay before you the reasons on which they are founded.
zh: 我坦率地向你们承认我的信念，并且我将自由地向你们阐述这些信念所依据的理由。
chunks: I frankly acknowledge
to you my convictions,
and I will freely lay
before you the reasons
on which they are founded.

text: It will therefore be of use to begin by examining the advantages of that Union, the certain evils, and the probable dangers, to which every State will be exposed from its dissolution.
zh: 因此，首先检查该联盟的优点、某些弊端以及每个州因联盟解体而可能面临的危险是有用的。
chunks: It will therefore be of use to begin
by examining the advantages of that Union, the certain evils,
and the probable dangers,
to which every State will be exposed
from its dissolution.

text: Whatever may be the arguments or inducements which have wrought this change in the sentiments and declarations of these gentlemen, it certainly would not be wise in the people at large to adopt these new political tenets without being fully convinced that they are founded in truth and sound policy.
chunks: Whatever may be the arguments or inducements which have wrought this change
in the sentiments and declarations of these gentlemen,
it certainly would not be wise in the people at large
to adopt these new political tenets
without being fully convinced that they are founded in truth and sound policy.

text: This intelligent people perceived and regretted these defects.
zh: 这个聪明人察觉到了这些缺陷并为此感到遗憾。
chunks: This intelligent people perceived
and regretted these defects.

text: That, in the course of the time they passed together in inquiring into and discussing the true interests of their country, they must have acquired very accurate knowledge on that head.
zh: 在他们一起探讨和讨论国家真正利益的过程中，他们一定在这方面获得了非常准确的认识。
chunks: That, in the course
of the time they passed together in inquiring
into and discussing the true interests of their country,
they must have acquired very accurate knowledge
on that head.

text: IT IS not a new observation that the people of any country (if, like the Americans, intelligent and wellinformed) seldom adopt and steadily persevere for many years in an erroneous opinion respecting their interests.
chunks: IT IS not a new observation
that the people of any country (if,
like the Americans, intelligent and wellinformed) seldom adopt
and steadily persevere for many years
in an erroneous opinion respecting their interests.

text: America has already formed treaties with no less than six foreign nations, and all of them, except Prussia, are maritime, and therefore able to annoy and injure us.
zh: 美国已经与至少六个国家签订了条约，而除普鲁士外，所有这些国家都是海上国家，因此能够骚扰和伤害我们。
chunks: America has already formed treaties
with no less than six foreign nations,
and all of them, except Prussia, are maritime,
and therefore able to annoy
and injure us.

text: States and not on others, naturally confines the causes of quarrel more immediately to the borderers.
zh: 国家而不是其他国家，自然将争吵的根源更直接地限制在边境地区。
chunks: States and not
on others,
naturally confines the causes
of quarrel more immediately
to the borderers.

text: As the safety of the whole is the interest of the whole, and cannot be provided for without government, either one or more or many, let us inquire whether one good government is not, relative to the object in question, more competent than any other given number whatever.
chunks: As the safety of the whole is the interest
of the whole, and cannot be provided
for without government, either one or more or many,
let us inquire whether one good government is not,
relative to the object in question, more competent than any other given number whatever.

text: But if one national government, had not so regulated the navigation of Britain as to make it a nursery for seamen--if one national government had not called forth all the national means and materials for forming fleets, their prowess and their thunder would never have been celebrated.
chunks: But if one national government, had not so regulated the navigation of Britain
as to make it a nursery
for seamen--if one national government had not called forth all the national means
and materials for forming fleets, their prowess
and their thunder would never have been celebrated.

text: How, and when, and in what proportion shall aids of men and money be afforded?
zh: 如何、何时、以何种比例提供人力和资金援助？
chunks: How,
and when,
and in what proportion shall aids
of men
and money be afforded?

text: This subject is copious and cannot easily be exhausted.
zh: 这个主题内容丰富，不容易穷尽。
chunks: This subject is copious
and cannot easily be exhausted.

text: Both those passions would lead them to countenance, if not to promote, whatever might promise to diminish her importance; and would also restrain them from measures calculated to advance or even to secure her prosperity.
zh: 这两种热情都会导致他们支持（如果不是提倡的话）任何可能削弱她重要性的事情。并且还会限制他们采取旨在促进甚至确保她的繁荣的措施。
chunks: Both those passions would lead them
to countenance, if not to promote, whatever might promise
to diminish her importance; and would also restrain them
from measures calculated to advance or even
to secure her prosperity.

text: NORTHERN confederacy would be the most desirous of preserving peace and friendship.
zh: 北方联盟将最渴望维护和平与友谊。
chunks: NORTHERN confederacy would be the most desirous
of preserving peace and friendship.

text: A man must be far gone in Utopian speculations who can seriously doubt that, if these States should either be wholly disunited, or only united in partial confederacies, the subdivisions into which they might be thrown would have frequent and violent contests with each other.
chunks: A man must be far gone in Utopian speculations who can seriously doubt that,
if these States should either be wholly disunited,
or only united in partial confederacies, the subdivisions
into which they might be thrown would have frequent
and violent contests with each other.

text: Men of this class, whether the favorites of a king or of a people, have in too many instances abused the confidence they possessed; and assuming the pretext of some public motive, have not scrupled to sacrifice the national tranquillity to personal advantage or personal gratification.
chunks: Men of this class, whether the favorites of a king
or of a people,
have in too many instances abused the confidence they possessed;
and assuming the pretext of some public motive, have not scrupled
to sacrifice the national tranquillity to personal advantage or personal gratification.

text: States, though dismembered and alienated from each other.
zh: 国家虽然被肢解并且彼此疏远。
chunks: States,
though dismembered
and alienated
from each other.

text: Are not popular assemblies frequently subject to the impulses of rage, resentment, jealousy, avarice, and of other irregular and violent propensities?
zh: 民众集会不是经常受到愤怒、怨恨、嫉妒、贪婪和其他不规则和暴力倾向的冲动吗？
chunks: Are not popular assemblies frequently subject
to the impulses
of rage, resentment, jealousy, avarice,
and of other irregular
and violent propensities?

text: Carthage, though a commercial republic, was the aggressor in the very war that ended in her destruction.
zh: 迦太基虽然是一个商业共和国，但却是那场最终导致其毁灭的战争的侵略者。
chunks: Carthage, though a commercial republic,
was the aggressor
in the very war
that ended
in her destruction.

text: The last war but between Britain and Spain sprang from the attempts of the British merchants to prosecute an illicit trade with the Spanish main.
zh: 英国和西班牙之间的最后一场战争源于英国商人试图起诉与西班牙主要国家的非法贸易。
chunks: The last war but between Britain
and Spain sprang from the attempts
of the British merchants
to prosecute an illicit trade
with the Spanish main.

text: Perhaps the greatest proportion of wars that have desolated the earth have sprung from this origin.
zh: 也许造成地球荒凉的大部分战争都是源于此。
chunks: Perhaps the greatest proportion
of wars that have desolated the earth have sprung from this origin.

text: At present, a large part of the vacant Western territory is, by cession at least, if not by any anterior right, the common property of the Union.
zh: 目前，大部分空置的西部领土，至少通过割让，如果不是通过任何在先权利，都是联邦的共同财产。
chunks: At present, a large part
of the vacant Western territory is,
by cession at least, if not
by any anterior right,
the common property of the Union.

text: The submission was made, and the court decided in favor of Pennsylvania.
zh: 提交意见后，法院做出了有利于宾夕法尼亚州的裁决。
chunks: The submission was made,
and the court decided
in favor
of Pennsylvania.

text: In a review of these transactions we may trace some of the causes which would be likely to embroil the States with each other, if it should be their unpropitious destiny to become disunited.
zh: 在审查这些交易时，我们可以追踪一些可能使各国相互卷入的原因，如果它们的不幸命运是分裂的话。
chunks: In a review of these transactions we may trace some
of the causes which would be likely
to embroil the States with each other,
if it should be their unpropitious destiny
to become disunited.

text: York, Connecticut, and New Jersey would afford an example of this kind.
zh: 约克、康涅狄格和新泽西就是这样的例子。
chunks: York, Connecticut,
and New Jersey would afford an example
of this kind.

text: The apportionment, in the first instance, and the progressive extinguishment afterward, would be alike productive of ill-humor and animosity.
zh: 首先的分配和随后的逐步消灭，同样会产生坏脾气和敌意。
chunks: The apportionment,
in the first instance,
and the progressive extinguishment afterward,
would be alike productive
of ill-humor and animosity.

text: The citizens of the States interested would clamour; foreign powers would urge for the satisfaction of their just demands, and the peace of the States would be hazarded to the double contingency of external invasion and internal contention.
zh: 感兴趣的国家的公民会大声叫嚷；外国列强会极力要求满足其正当要求，国家的和平就会受到外侵和内乱的双重威胁。
chunks: The citizens of the States interested would clamour;
foreign powers would urge for the satisfaction
of their just demands, and the peace
of the States would be hazarded to the double contingency
of external invasion and internal contention.

text: Laws in violation of private contracts, as they amount to aggressions on the rights of those States whose citizens are injured by them, may be considered as another probable source of hostility.
zh: 违反私人合同的法律，因为它们构成对其公民受到伤害的国家权利的侵犯，可被视为另一个可能的敌对根源。
chunks: Laws in violation of private contracts,
as they amount to aggressions
on the rights of those States
whose citizens are injured by them, may be considered
as another probable source of hostility.

text: The history of war, in that quarter of the globe, is no longer a history of nations subdued and empires overturned, but of towns taken and retaken; of battles that decide nothing; of retreats more beneficial than victories; of much effort and little acquisition.
chunks: The history of war, in that quarter of the globe,
is no longer a history
of nations subdued and empires overturned, but of towns taken
and retaken; of battles that decide nothing; of retreats more beneficial
than victories; of much effort and little acquisition.

text: Safety from external danger is the most powerful director of national conduct.
zh: 免受外部危险的安全是国家行为最有力的指导者。
chunks: Safety from external danger is the most powerful director
of national conduct.

text: They would, at the same time, be necessitated to strengthen the executive arm of government, in doing which their constitutions would acquire a progressive direction toward monarchy.
zh: 与此同时，他们有必要加强政府的行政机构，这样做他们的宪法将获得朝着君主制进步的方向。
chunks: They would, at the same time,
be necessitated to strengthen the executive arm
of government, in doing
which their constitutions would acquire a progressive direction
toward monarchy.

text: The industrious habits of the people of the present day, absorbed in the pursuits of gain, and devoted to the improvements of agriculture and commerce, are incompatible with the condition of a nation of soldiers, which was the true condition of the people of those republics.
chunks: The industrious habits of the people of the present day, absorbed in the pursuits
of gain, and devoted to the improvements
of agriculture and commerce, are incompatible with the condition
of a nation of soldiers, which was the true condition
of the people of those republics.

text: The military state becomes elevated above the civil.
zh: 军事国家的地位高于民事国家。
chunks: The military state becomes elevated
above the civil.

text: If we are wise enough to preserve the Union we may for ages enjoy an advantage similar to that of an insulated situation.
zh: 如果我们有足够的智慧来维护联邦，我们可能会在很长一段时间内享有类似于孤立局势的优势。
chunks: If we are wise enough
to preserve the Union we may
for ages enjoy an advantage similar
to that
of an insulated situation.

text: If now and then intervals of felicity open to view, we behold them with a mixture of regret, arising from the reflection that the pleasing scenes before us are soon to be overwhelmed by the tempestuous waves of sedition and party rage.
zh: 如果时不时地看到一段幸福的时光，我们会带着一种复杂的遗憾看到它们，因为我们想到，我们面前的令人愉快的场景很快就会被暴风雨般的叛乱和政党愤怒所淹没。
chunks: If now and then intervals of felicity open to view, we behold them
with a mixture of regret,
arising from the reflection that the pleasing scenes
before us are soon to be overwhelmed
by the tempestuous waves of sedition and party rage.

text: The latter is that which immediately concerns the object under consideration.
zh: 后者是与所考虑的对象直接相关的。
chunks: The latter is
that which immediately concerns the object under consideration.

text: And this is the true question, in the discussion of which we are at present interested.
zh: 这是我们目前感兴趣的讨论的真正问题。
chunks: And this is the true question,
in the discussion
of which we are
at present interested.

text: Were he to subdue a part, that which would still remain free might oppose him with forces independent of those which he had usurped and overpower him before he could be settled in his usurpation.
zh: 如果他征服了一部分，那么仍然保持自由的部分可能会以独立于他所篡夺的力量的力量来反对他，并在他能够确定他的篡夺之前压倒他。
chunks: Were he to subdue a part,
that which would still remain free might oppose him
with forces independent of those
which he had usurped and overpower him
before he could be settled in his usurpation.

text: An exact equality of suffrage between the members has also been insisted upon as a leading feature of a confederate government.
zh: 成员之间的选举权完全平等也被坚持作为邦联政府的一个主要特征。
chunks: An exact equality
of suffrage
between the members has also been insisted
upon as a leading feature
of a confederate government.

text: This was certainly the most, delicate species of interference in their internal administration; for if there be any thing that seems exclusively appropriated to the local jurisdictions, it is the appointment of their own officers.
zh: 这无疑是对其内部管理最微妙的干扰。因为如果说有什么事情似乎只适合当地司法管辖区的话，那就是任命他们自己的官员。
chunks: This was certainly the most,
delicate species of interference in their internal administration;
for if there be any thing
that seems exclusively appropriated to the local jurisdictions,
it is the appointment of their own officers.

text: However anxiously we may wish that these complaints had no foundation, the evidence, of known facts will not permit us to deny that they are in some degree true.
zh: 无论我们多么焦急地希望这些抱怨没有根据，已知事实的证据不允许我们否认它们在某种程度上是真实的。
chunks: However anxiously we may wish
that these complaints had no foundation, the evidence,
of known facts will not permit us
to deny that they are
in some degree true.

text: As long as the connection subsists between his reason and his self-love, his opinions and his passions will have a reciprocal influence on each other; and the former will be objects to which the latter will attach themselves.
zh: 只要他的理性和自爱之间存在联系，他的观点和他的激情就会相互影响；前者将成为后者所依附的对象。
chunks: As long as the connection subsists
between his reason and his self-love, his opinions
and his passions will have a reciprocal influence
on each other; and the former will be objects
to which the latter will attach themselves.

text: The regulation of these various and interfering interests forms the principal task of modern legislation, and involves the spirit of party and faction in the necessary and ordinary operations of the government.
zh: 对这些不同的、相互干扰的利益的调节构成了现代立法的主要任务，并在政府的必要和日常运作中涉及党派精神。
chunks: The regulation of these various
and interfering interests forms the principal task
of modern legislation, and involves the spirit
of party and faction
in the necessary and ordinary operations of the government.

text: Every shilling with which they overburden the inferior number, is a shilling saved to their own pockets.
zh: 他们使劣等人负担过重的每一先令，都是省到自己口袋里的一先令。
chunks: Every shilling
with which they overburden the inferior number,
is a shilling saved
to their own pockets.

text: Evidently by one of two only.
zh: 显然只有两个人之一。
chunks: Evidently by one
of two only.

text: Let us examine the points in which it varies from pure democracy, and we shall comprehend both the nature of the cure and the efficacy which it must derive from the Union.
zh: 让我们考察一下它与纯粹民主的不同点，我们就会理解治愈方法的本质以及它必须从联邦中获得的功效。
chunks: Let us examine the points
in which it varies from pure democracy,
and we shall comprehend both the nature
of the cure and the efficacy
which it must derive from the Union.

text: Does the advantage consist in the substitution of representatives whose enlightened views and virtuous sentiments render them superior to local prejudices and schemes of injustice?
zh: 优势是否在于替换那些具有开明观点和高尚情感的代表，使他们优于当地的偏见和不公正的计划？
chunks: Does the advantage consist
in the substitution of representatives
whose enlightened views
and virtuous sentiments render them superior
to local prejudices and schemes of injustice?

text: Britain (with whom we have at present no treaty of commerce) from all our ports; what would be the probable operation of this step upon her politics?
zh: 英国（目前与我们没有商业条约）从我们所有的港口；这一步骤可能会对她的政治产生什么影响？
chunks: Britain (with whom we have
at present no treaty of commerce)
from all our ports;
what would be the probable operation
of this step upon her politics?

text: This would be more peculiarly the case in relation to operations in the West Indies.
zh: 对于西印度群岛的行动来说，情况更为特殊。
chunks: This would be more peculiarly the case
in relation to operations in the West Indies.

text: Under a vigorous national government, the natural strength and resources of the country, directed to a common interest, would baffle all the combinations of European jealousy to restrain our growth.
zh: 在一个充满活力的国家政府的领导下，国家的自然力量和资源，为了共同利益，将挫败欧洲的所有嫉妒，从而限制我们的发展。
chunks: Under a vigorous national government,
the natural strength and resources of the country,
directed to a common interest,
would baffle all the combinations
of European jealousy to restrain our growth.

text: They, of course, would hardly remain long indifferent to that decided mastery, of which experience has shown us to be possessed in this valuable branch of traffic, and by which we are able to undersell those nations in their own markets.
zh: 当然，他们不会长期对这种决定性的掌握保持无动于衷，经验表明我们在这一宝贵的交通领域中拥有这种掌握，并且通过这种掌握，我们能够在这些国家自己的市场上以低价出售。
chunks: They, of course, would hardly remain long indifferent
to that decided mastery, of which experience has shown us
to be possessed in this valuable branch
of traffic, and by which we are able
to undersell those nations in their own markets.

text: The more southern States furnish in greater abundance certain kinds of naval stores--tar, pitch, and turpentine.
zh: 越南部的州提供越多的某些海军物资——焦油、沥青和松节油。
chunks: The more southern States furnish
in greater abundance certain kinds
of naval stores--tar, pitch,
and turpentine.

text: The variety, not less than the value, of products for exportation contributes to the activity of foreign commerce.
zh: 出口产品的多样性（不少于价值）有助于对外贸易活动。
chunks: The variety, not less
than the value, of products
for exportation contributes
to the activity
of foreign commerce.

text: The superiority she has long maintained has tempted her to plume herself as the Mistress of the World, and to consider the rest of mankind as created for her benefit.
zh: 她长期以来保持的优越感诱使她自诩为世界之主，并认为其他人类都是为了她的利益而创造的。
chunks: The superiority she has long maintained has tempted her
to plume herself as the Mistress
of the World,
and to consider the rest
of mankind as created for her benefit.

text: Its tendency to promote the interests of revenue will be the subject of our present inquiry.
zh: 其促进收入利益的倾向将是我们当前调查的主题。
chunks: Its tendency
to promote the interests of revenue will be the subject of our present inquiry.

text: In some parts of this territory are to be found the best gold and silver mines in Europe.
zh: 在该地区的某些地区可以找到欧洲最好的金矿和银矿。
chunks: In some parts
of this territory are to be found the best gold and silver mines in Europe.

text: In America, it is evident that we must a long time depend for the means of revenue chiefly on such duties.
zh: 在美国，很明显，我们的收入来源必须长期主要依赖于此类关税。
chunks: In America, it is evident
that we must a long time depend
for the means
of revenue chiefly
on such duties.

text: Mr. Neckar computes the number of these patrols at upwards of twenty thousand.
zh: 内卡先生计算出这些巡逻队的人数超过两万人。
chunks: Mr. Neckar computes the number
of these patrols at upwards of twenty thousand.

text: The United States lie at a great distance from Europe, and at a considerable distance from all other places with which they would have extensive connections of foreign trade.
zh: 美国距欧洲很远，距所有其他与它们有广泛对外贸易联系的地方也相距相当远。
chunks: The United States lie
at a great distance from Europe,
and at a considerable distance from all other places
with which they would have extensive connections
of foreign trade.

text: There is, perhaps, nothing so much a subject of national extravagance as these spirits.
zh: 也许，没有什么比这些精神更能成为民族奢侈的话题了。
chunks: There is, perhaps,
nothing so much a subject
of national extravagance
as these spirits.

text: And as, on the other hand, the wants of the government can never obtain an adequate supply, unless all the sources of revenue are open to its demands, the finances of the community, under such embarrassments, cannot be put into a situation consistent with its respectability or its security.
chunks: And as, on the other hand, the wants
of the government can never obtain an adequate supply,
unless all the sources of revenue are open
to its demands, the finances of the community, under such embarrassments,
cannot be put into a situation consistent with its respectability or its security.

text: According to this distribution, each confederacy would comprise an extent of territory larger than that of the kingdom of Great Britain.
zh: 根据这种分布，每个邦联的领土面积都大于大不列颠王国。
chunks: According to this distribution,
each confederacy would comprise an extent
of territory larger than that
of the kingdom
of Great Britain.

text: Pennsylvania would have strong inducements to join the Northern league.
zh: 宾夕法尼亚州将有强烈的诱因加入北方联盟。
chunks: Pennsylvania would have strong inducements
to join the Northern league.

text: This reflection must have great weight in obviating that objection to the proposed plan, which is founded on the principle of expense; an objection, however, which, when we come to take a nearer view of it, will appear in every light to stand on mistaken ground.
chunks: This reflection must have great weight in obviating that objection
to the proposed plan, which is founded on the principle of expense;
an objection, however, which, when we come
to take a nearer view of it, will appear
in every light to stand on mistaken ground.

text: To this accidental source of the error may be added the artifice of some celebrated authors, whose writings have had a great share in forming the modern standard of political opinions.
zh: 除了这个偶然的错误来源之外，还可能加上一些著名作家的技巧，他们的著作对现代政治观点标准的形成起了很大的作用。
chunks: To this accidental source
of the error may be added the artifice
of some celebrated authors,
whose writings have had a great share
in forming the modern standard of political opinions.

text: Taking the mean for the distance, the amount will be eight hundred and sixty-eight miles and three-fourths.
